name: Reliability
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of reliability as a mark of godly character and faithful stewardship. Believers are called to be trustworthy in both small and great matters, as faithfulness leads to greater responsibility and blessing, while unfaithfulness brings instability and harm. Honest and clear communication is also essential, avoiding deceit or double-mindedness, so that others may trust in one's word. Ultimately, the reliability of Christ's testimony assures us that truth is the foundation for faith and confidence.
